topic: Safety precautions to be observed while working on advanced electronic systems.
syllabus_extract: Safety precautions to be observed while working on advanced electronic systems.
specific_objectives: 20.7.1.3 Trainee will be able to observe safety precautions.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of ESD wrist strap usage, inspection of tool grounding, and verification of power isolation procedures.
intro_questions: What is the primary risk when handling sensitive electronic components?
Why must power be isolated before working on avionics?
What personal protective equipment is required for ESD safety?

development.content:
Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) hazards
Grounding and bonding procedures
Power isolation protocols
Tool and equipment safety checks

Handling of high-voltage circuits
Use of insulated tools
Lockout/Tagout procedures
Emergency shutdown protocols

Work area cleanliness standards
Cable management and routing
Personal hygiene and contamination control
Reporting of anomalies

summary_questions: Explain the correct sequence for donning an ESD wrist strap.
Describe the steps required to safely isolate power on an avionics unit.
List three critical safety checks before reconnecting a high-voltage system.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the specific safety precautions required for the next lesson plan (LP 02) regarding system testing procedures.
